The [[Gallis-Tech]] '''48 Roller''' was a one-being [[wheel bike]] in use following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:JanTosh48RollerWheelBike-TLP.png|thumb|left|250px|Jann Tosh's wheel bike]]
The 48 Roller was essentially a single large wheel, with its motor and seats contained within its circumference.

A variant of the type seen in the early years of the Empire had a pair of outrigger pods on either side, each with three seats, the central seat on each side being raised higher for a pilot and equipped with handlebars.<ref name="TLP" />

However, the normal capacity of the type is stated as just one pilot and one passenger, with the pilot sitting within the wheel, and steering using a combination of handlebars and shifting body weight.<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
[[Jann Tosh]] owned a 48 Roller on [[Tyne's Horky]], a mining world where such vehicles were popular.<ref name="TLP" />

The bi-wheeled [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]] [[General/Legends|General]] used by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the Clone Wars was noted as being similar in design to the uniwheel 48 Roller.<ref name="LoW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

Some insurgent groups created armed versions of the 48 Roller by fitting them with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="TUR" />

Gallis-Tech also produced a two-seater wheelbike type with somewhat differing characteristics, which was modified into the single-seat [[Scout Wheelbike]] used by some [[COMPNOR Regiment]]s in place of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="SWAJ6">{{JournalCite|6|The Cure}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The real-life counterpart to the wheel bike is the [[Wikipedia:Monowheel|monowheel]].

The original depiction of the 48 Roller differs considerably fron the more recent descriptions in sourcebooks, which appear to be influenced by the [[Scout Wheelbike]], although enough differences of detail remain to confirm the distinction between the two types.
